# Approved third-party 3D sources

Only assets with an explicit redistribution/commercial-use license may enter the shipped game.

## Quaternius — Zombie Apocalypse Kit
- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html
- License: CC0
- Formats: glTF, FBX, OBJ, Blend
- Planned use: playable survivors, zombie families, vehicles, barricades and urban props.
- Import target: `res://assets/third_party/quaternius/zombie_apocalypse/`

## Quaternius — Sci-Fi Essentials Kit
- Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/scifiessentialskit.html
- License: CC0
- Formats: glTF, FBX, OBJ; source pack also provides a Godot implementation.
- Planned use: firearms, robots, crates, screens, sci-fi props, hologram/shader references.
- Import target: `res://assets/third_party/quaternius/scifi_essentials/`

## Poly Haven — Concrete Tiles 02
- Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_tiles_02
- License: CC0
- Planned use: arena floor albedo/normal/roughness at a mobile-appropriate resolution.
- Import target: `res://assets/third_party/polyhaven/concrete_tiles_02/`

Do not import proprietary Zombie Waves art, meshes, textures, audio, shaders or animations. Zombie Waves is a presentation/game-feel benchmark only.
